title: Russian intelligence sends an armed team to protect CIA officers during the 1993 coup attempt against Yeltsin

tellings.quote: He said, "Okay, Ralph, here's some very extraordinary circumstances. We're going to send you a team of heavily armed guys to try to keep you from getting captured.

plain: During the 1993 attempt to overthrow Boris Yeltsin, then Russia's president, Russian intelligence is said to have sent a team of heavily armed men to keep American spies at the ambassador's residence in Moscow from being captured. A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, who was there, says his Russian counterpart called it "very extraordinary circumstances" and offered the guards. He mentions the US ambassador of the time, Tom Pickering. If true, it shows the two rival services working together at a moment of real danger.
